info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Products API
Products
Shopify Retrieve a list of products

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of product IDs to retrieve

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (max 250, default 50)

params.name: since_id
params.description: Return products after the specified ID

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Show products created after this date (ISO 8601)

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Show products created before this date (ISO 8601)

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Show products updated after this date (ISO 8601)

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Show products updated before this date (ISO 8601)

items.docs: Retrieves a list of products. Results can be filtered by collection, product type, vendor, creation date, update date, publication status, and other criteria. Returns up to 250 products per page.

info.name: Shopify Create a new product

items.docs: Creates a new product. You can include product variants and images in the same request. If no variants are specified a default variant is created automatically.

info.name: Shopify Retrieve a count of products

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Count products created after this date

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Count products updated after this date

items.docs: Retrieves a count of products matching the specified criteria.

info.name: Shopify Retrieve a single product

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include

items.docs: Retrieves a single product by its ID, including variants, images, and options.

info.name: Shopify Update a product

items.docs: Updates an existing product and any of its variants and images.

info.name: Shopify Delete a product

items.docs: Deletes a product and all associated variants and images.

info.name: Shopify Retrieve a product by its handle

items.docs: Retrieves product information in JSON format using the product handle. Returns product metadata, pricing, variants (up to 250), images, options, and availability. Monetary values reflect the customer presentment currency.

info.name: Shopify Retrieves A List Of Products

params.name: ids
params.description: Return only products specified by a comma-separated list of product IDs.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Return up to this many results per page.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: since_id
params.description: Restrict results to after the specified ID.

params.name: status
params.description:
Return products by their status.
                  (default: active)
                    
                        active: Show only active products.
                        archived: Show only archived products.
                        draft: Show only draft products.

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Filter results by product collection ID.

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Show products last updated after date. (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00)

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Show products last updated before date. (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00)

params.name: published_status
params.description:
Return products by their published status
                  (default: any)
                    
                        published: Show only published products.
                        unpublished: Show only unpublished products.
                        any: Show all products.

params.name: fields
params.description: Show only certain fields, specified by a comma-separated list of field names.

params.name: presentment_currencies
params.description: Return presentment prices in only certain currencies, specified by a comma-separated list of ISO 4217 currency codes.

params.description: An array of product IDs, in the order that you want them to appear at the top of the collection. When products is specified but empty, any previously sorted products are cleared.

params.name: sort_order
params.description:
The type of sorting to apply. Valid values are listed in the Properties section above.
